From 60862846308627e9e15546bb647a00de44deb27b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 20:11:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mt76: mt7996: Fix possible oob access in
 mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211()

Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields in
mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211 in order to avoid a possible oob access.

Fixes: 98686cd21624c ("wifi: mt76: mt7996: add driver for MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) devices")
Signed-off-by: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260226-mt76-addba-req-oob-access-v1-1-b0f6d1ad4850@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
index 2560e2f46e89..d4f3ee943b47 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
@@ -800,6 +800,7 @@ mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211(struct mt7996_dev *dev, __le32 *txwi,
 	u32 val;
 
 	if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
+	    skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
 		if (is_mt7990(&dev->mt76))
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a potential out-of-bounds (oob) access in the `mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211()` function in `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c`. The modification adds a length validation check before accessing the management frame's action category and ADDBA request action code. Specifically, the new condition `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` ensures that the skb length is sufficient to contain the minimum action frame header plus the one-byte action code, preventing access beyond the actual data when handling 802.11 action frames. No other files are changed.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
Reason:
The code directly accesses mgmt->u.action fields (category and action code) without verifying that the skb has enough length to contain them. This can cause an out-of-bounds read when processing short or malformed frames.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
    skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 &&
    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
Reason:
The added check ensures the skb contains at least the minimum required length for an action frame plus one more byte (for the action code) before accessing the category and action code fields. This prevents out-of-bounds access by only proceeding when the frame is long enough.
